start.lede: You are the coach. Draft a team of up to five heroes, send them down the lanes and watch the match play itself. Break the enemy throne before they break yours.

steps.shop: Buy heroes in the shop. Three copies of a hero merge into one with an extra star.
steps.lanes: Drag heroes to top, mid and bot. Synergies only work between heroes on the same lane.
steps.fight: Press Fight and watch the lanes push. Damage to towers and the throne carries over for the rest of the match.
steps.grow: Save gold, buy experience and items: every level lets one more hero onto the map.

carry.name: Carry
carry.passive: Farm: +{perHit}% damage per last hit this round, up to +{max}%.

support.name: Support
support.passive: Aura: nearby allied heroes regenerate {percent}% health per second.

initiator.name: Initiator
initiator.passive: Starts each round and respawns with {percent}% mana.

pusher.name: Pusher
pusher.passive: Deals {mult} times more damage to structures. Creeps on its lane deal +{bonus}% damage.

ganker.name: Ganker
ganker.passive: Roams the whole map and hunts wounded heroes on any lane. Never attacks towers or the throne: with nobody to fight, goes after enemy creeps, on another lane if needed. {speed}% faster and evades {evasion}% of attacks.

innate.bash: Bash: {chance}% chance for an attack to stun the target for {stun} s.

abilities.charge: Leaps to the farthest enemy within {radius}: {damage} damage and a {stun} s stun.
abilities.volley: {arrows} arrows at the nearest enemies, {damage} damage each.
abilities.prayer: Heals the most wounded nearby allied hero for {heal}.
abilities.barrel: Explosion dealing {damage} area damage. Structures take {structureBonus} times more.
abilities.chainLightning: Lightning jumps between {bounces} enemies: {damage} damage to the first, {falloff}% less to each next one.
abilities.poisonDagger: Dagger at the most wounded hero: {damage} damage, then {poison} poison every {tick} s for {duration} s and a {slow}% slow.
abilities.backstab: Appears behind the most wounded hero within {radius} and hits for {damage}.
abilities.fireball: Fireball into the densest group of enemies: {damage} area damage.
abilities.roots: Roots enemies around the target for {duration} s and deals {damage} damage. Heals nearby allies for {heal}.
abilities.whirl: Spins for {duration} s, hitting everyone nearby for {damage} every {tick} s.
abilities.leap: Jumps into the enemy crowd: {damage} damage and a {stun} s stun to everyone nearby.
abilities.raiseDead: Summons {count} skeletons for {lifetime} s. Each has {hp} health and hits for {damage}. At most {maxAlive} skeletons at a time.
abilities.blizzard: Storm for {duration} s: {damage} damage every {tick} s and a {slow}% slow.
abilities.quake: Stuns every enemy nearby for {stun} s and deals {damage} damage.
abilities.turret: Deploys a turret for {lifetime} s with {hp} health and {damage} damage per shot. It hits structures too.
abilities.hook: Pulls the farthest hero within {radius}: {damage} damage and a {stun} s stun.
abilities.assassinate: Shoots the most wounded hero within {radius} for {damage} damage.
abilities.shield: Gives up to {targets} most wounded allies a shield that absorbs {absorb} damage for {duration} s.

trilane.name: Trilane
trilane.effect: +{maxHp}% health for every hero on the lane.

siege.name: Siege
siege.effect: Heroes on the lane deal {structureDamage}% more damage to structures.

hunt.name: Hunt
hunt.effect: The ganker and the initiator deal {damage}% more damage.

arcane.name: Arcane
arcane.effect: Mage abilities are {spellPower}% stronger and mana builds {manaGain}% faster.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.effect: +{maxHp}% health and {damageTaken}% less damage taken for the whole lane.

items.broadsword: {critChance}% chance for an attack to crit for {critMultiplier}% damage
items.chalice: +{healPower}% healing from abilities and the aura
items.vampireFang: Heals for {lifesteal}% of attack damage and {spellLifesteal}% of ability damage
items.thornMail: Returns {thorns}% of attack damage to the attacker
items.aegis: Once per round prevents death and restores {revive}% health

welcome.title: Welcome, coach
welcome.text: A few quick steps to show you around. Close the tour with the cross and reopen it any time from the menu.

board.title: The map
board.threeLanes: Three lanes: top, mid and bot. Your base is bottom left, the enemy base is top right. Each lane has a tower with the throne behind them. Destroy the enemy throne to win.
board.twoLanes: Two lanes: top and bot, with the jungle between them. Your base is on the left, the enemy base on the right. Each lane has a tower with the throne behind them. Destroy the enemy throne to win.
board.oneLane: One lane: a long bridge. Your base is bottom left, the enemy base is top right. Each side has two towers on the bridge, and heal relics wait in the middle. A round goes to building damage and kills.

shop.title: Hero shop
shop.text: Click a card to buy the hero. The price is in the top right corner. When a card shows “★★ on buy”, buying it upgrades your hero right away.

economy.title: Gold and level
economy.text: Reroll gives new cards for 2 gold. XP raises your team level: each level lets one more hero onto the map.

bench.title: Heroes
bench.text: Heroes you buy land here. Drag them straight onto a lane on the map.

place.title: Placing heroes
place.text: Drag a hero onto a lane, or click the hero and then the lane. Heroes on the same lane give each other synergies.

tracker.title: Lanes
tracker.text: Each lane shows your heroes against the enemy’s and which synergies are active on both sides. Dashed badges show who you need for the next synergy. An empty lane is a gift to the enemy.

items.title: Items
items.text: The Items tab sells upgrades. Click a bought item in the stash, then a hero, or just drag it: every hero has two slots. The item card also lets you sell it.

scoreboard.title: Score
scoreboard.text: Health of both sides' towers and thrones. Structure damage carries over between rounds.

fight.title: Fight
fight.text: When your team is ready, press Fight. The battle plays itself; you can speed it up or skip it. Good luck!

modes.title: Three modes
modes.text: You are learning on two lanes. There is also the classic three lanes and a quick fight on one, across a bridge. Pick the mode when you start a match; each has its own duel rating.

difficultyHint.relaxed: No timer: the battle starts when you press Fight.
difficultyHint.standard: {s} s to plan. When time runs out, the battle starts on its own.
